1.4.0.title: The Web Surface
features: MewBit now has a website: a landing page, a searchable command reference, and this changelog — all served from your own instance, so the numbers and the command list are yours, not a marketing page's
A per-server dashboard for everything the bot remembers: player channel, default source, DJ mode, server logs, tickets, the equalizer, and per-server statistics

Dashboard access starts with the server owner alone. The owner can then name specific people as operators — Discord's Administrator permission no longer grants anything, because it is handed out far more widely than the power to change how the bot behaves for everyone
Every dashboard change is recorded: who made it, when, and what it went from and to
An embed composer with a live preview, so you can see the message before it is sent instead of guessing inside a Discord modal
Server playlists can be renamed and removed from the dashboard, including ones whose creator has left the server
Instance diagnostics: uptime, memory, event-loop lag, Lavalink connection and restart counters
fixes: Rate limits now count each visitor separately behind a reverse proxy. They previously shared one bucket, so a single visitor could lock everyone else out
The sign-in screen no longer promises access to anyone holding Administrator, a rule that stopped being true when access became owner-first
Authenticated dashboard reads are now rate limited at all; they were unbounded
A malformed session cookie is ignored instead of failing the request
The session cap now evicts expired sessions before live ones, instead of signing out whoever had been working longest
The Activity no longer strands its ownership lease when a lookup throws
changes: The OAuth redirect URI derives from one variable, and the bot prints the exact value to register at startup
The Activity moved to its own hostname, so the public domain belongs to the website

1.3.0.title: Autoplay V3 and the AI DJ
features: Autoplay V3 scores candidates on musical fit — artist relation, album, chart position and provider agreement — instead of taking whatever a provider returned first
Optional AI DJ: an OpenAI model plans the next few transitions, and every proposal is verified against a real provider catalogue entry before it can play
Autoplay stays inside the vibe of what people actually queued by hand, rather than drifting genre by genre until it is somewhere else entirely
Artist and album streak limits, so one artist cannot quietly take over the room
Autoplay picks stay marked in the queue, so nobody wonders where a track came from
24/7 radio mode keeps a room playing continuously
fixes: Spotify mirrors are verified against a playable source before being used as a fallback
Stalled queue transitions now recover instead of leaving the player stuck
YouTube TV playback restored after upstream signature changes
Autoplay no longer repeats a recording that was skipped moments earlier
changes: Added an autoplay soak and replay simulator: hundreds of decisions can be exercised without joining a voice channel (pnpm test:autoplay:soak)
AI DJ web search is off by default, because it costs money per lookup
Autoplay scoring no longer depends on Spotify being configured

1.2.0.title: The Discord Activity
features: A shared visual player that opens inside the voice channel. Everyone works from the same queue, the same artwork and the same transport — there is no host who sees more than the rest
Search every provider from the Activity and play or queue without leaving the channel
Synced lyrics, line by line, with a per-user timing offset for when a source runs early
The fifteen-band equalizer and thirteen one-click effects, applied to the live player
Browse, create and edit playlists from the Activity
A compact view that keeps the transport reachable while the Activity is minimised
The voice channel status names whatever is currently playing
fixes: The Activity's OAuth handshake is guarded against a partial launch
Player state reconciles with the live player instead of drifting after a reconnect
Sliders stay stable while a state update arrives mid-drag
Volume is restored correctly after unmuting
changes: The Activity is served as static files with the gateway proxied under /api, so it can sit behind any reverse proxy
Views are lazy-loaded, so the first paint does not wait for the whole app
